question: How many customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Customer;

question: List the names of all genres in alphabetical order.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Genre ORDER BY Name;

question: What is the highest unit price of any track?
gold_sql: SELECT max(UnitPrice) FROM Track;

question: How many customers live in Brazil?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil';

question: Show the first and last names of all sales support agents.
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent';

question: What is the total amount of all invoices combined?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(Total) FROM Invoice;

question: Which album titles contain the word 'Greatest'?
gold_sql: SELECT Title FROM Album WHERE Title ILIKE '%greatest%';

question: What is the average track length in minutes?
gold_sql: SELECT avg(Milliseconds) / 60000.0 FROM Track;

question: Give the names of tracks longer than 20 minutes.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 20 * 60000;

question: How many tracks does each genre have? Show the genre name and the number of tracks.
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, count(*) FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name;

question: Which artist has the most albums? Show the artist name.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Who are the 3 customers who spent the most? Show first name, last name, and total spent, from highest to lowest.
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, sum(i.Total) AS total FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 3;

question: What are the 5 billing countries with the most revenue? Show the country and revenue, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, sum(Total) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

question: How many invoices were issued in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Invoice WHERE year(InvoiceDate) = 2023;

question: What was the total revenue in each year? Order by year.
gold_sql: SELECT year(InvoiceDate) AS year, sum(Total) FROM Invoice GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;

question: List the titles of all albums by AC/DC.
gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC';

question: List the names of the tracks on the album 'Let There Be Rock'.
gold_sql: SELECT t.Name FROM Track t JOIN Album a ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId WHERE a.Title = 'Let There Be Rock';

question: How many tracks are there of each media type? Show the media type name and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT m.Name, count(*) FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name;

question: What is the average invoice total for each billing country?
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, avg(Total) FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry;

question: Which employees report directly to Nancy Edwards? Show their first and last names.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId WHERE m.FirstName = 'Nancy' AND m.LastName = 'Edwards';

question: How many customers does each support representative look after? Show the employee's first name, last name, and number of customers.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, count(*) FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName;

question: Show the id and name of every playlist with more than 1000 tracks.
gold_sql: SELECT p.PlaylistId, p.Name FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId, p.Name HAVING count(*) > 1000;

question: What is the average track price in each genre? Show the genre name and average price.
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, avg(t.UnitPrice) FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name;

question: Which composers are credited on more than 20 tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT Composer FROM Track WHERE Composer IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Composer HAVING count(*) > 20;

question: Which genre brought in the most revenue from sales? Show the genre name and revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, sum(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which 3 artists sold the most tracks? Show the artist name and number of tracks sold, from most to least.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, sum(il.Quantity) AS sold FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY sold DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Which customers bought at least one Jazz track? Show first and last names.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz';

question: What is the total revenue from the customers of each support representative? Show the employee's first name, last name, and revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, sum(i.Total) FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName;

question: How many tracks have never been sold?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Track WHERE TrackId NOT IN (SELECT TrackId FROM InvoiceLine);

question: What are the 5 longest albums by total running time? Show the album title and its length in minutes, longest first.
gold_sql: SELECT a.Title, sum(t.Milliseconds) / 60000.0 AS minutes FROM Album a JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId GROUP BY a.AlbumId, a.Title ORDER BY minutes DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which artists have tracks in more than one genre? Show the artist names.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name HAVING count(DISTINCT t.GenreId) > 1;

question: What percentage of tracks are longer than 5 minutes?
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE Milliseconds > 300000) / count(*) FROM Track;

question: Which employee has worked at the company the longest? Show first name, last name, and hire date.
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, HireDate FROM Employee ORDER BY HireDate LIMIT 1;

question: Which customers spent more than the average customer? Show first and last names.
gold_sql: WITH spend AS (SELECT CustomerId, sum(Total) AS total FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId) SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN spend s ON s.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE s.total > (SELECT avg(total) FROM spend);

question: For each year, which genre sold the most tracks? Show the year, genre name, and quantity sold, ordered by year.
gold_sql: SELECT year(i.InvoiceDate) AS year, g.Name, sum(il.Quantity) AS sold FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY year, g.GenreId, g.Name QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY sold DESC) = 1 ORDER BY year;

question: For each month of 2025, show the month number, the revenue, and the change from the previous month, ordered by month.
gold_sql: SELECT month, revenue, revenue - lag(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change FROM (SELECT month(InvoiceDate) AS month, sum(Total) AS revenue FROM Invoice WHERE year(InvoiceDate) = 2025 GROUP BY month) ORDER BY month;

question: What share of sales revenue comes from each media type, as a percentage? Show the media type name and percentage.
gold_sql: SELECT m.Name, 100.0 * sum(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) / sum(sum(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity)) OVER () FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name;

question: Which customers made a purchase in every year from 2021 to 2025? Show first and last names.
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE year(i.InvoiceDate) BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025 GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName HAVING count(DISTINCT year(i.InvoiceDate)) = 5;

question: Among artists with at least 10 tracks, whose tracks have the longest average duration? Show the artist name and average minutes.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, avg(t.Milliseconds) / 60000.0 AS minutes FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name HAVING count(*) >= 10 ORDER BY minutes DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List every employee's first and last name with their manager's first and last name (empty for employees without a manager).
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, m.FirstName, m.LastName FROM Employee e LEFT JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId;

question: For each month of 2022, show the month number and the running total of revenue, ordered by month.
gold_sql: SELECT month, sum(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS running_total FROM (SELECT month(InvoiceDate) AS month, sum(Total) AS revenue FROM Invoice WHERE year(InvoiceDate) = 2022 GROUP BY month) ORDER BY month;

question: Which playlists contain no tracks at all?
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Playlist WHERE PlaylistId NOT IN (SELECT PlaylistId FROM PlaylistTrack);

question: How many countries are in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM countries;

question: List the countries in the South Asia region.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM countries WHERE region = 'South Asia';

question: What is the capital city of Japan?
gold_sql: SELECT capital_city FROM countries WHERE name = 'Japan';

question: How many countries are classified as low income?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM countries WHERE income_group = 'Low income';

question: What was the population of India in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT s.population FROM country_stats s JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = s.iso3 WHERE c.name = 'India' AND s.year = 2023;

question: Which 5 countries had the largest population in 2023? Show the name and population, largest first.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, s.population FROM country_stats s JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = s.iso3 WHERE s.year = 2023 ORDER BY s.population DESC LIMIT 5;

question: How many countries are in each income group?
gold_sql: SELECT income_group, count(*) FROM countries GROUP BY income_group;

question: Which country had the highest GDP per capita in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM country_stats s JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = s.iso3 WHERE s.year = 2023 ORDER BY s.gdp_per_capita_usd DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1;

question: What was the combined population of all countries in each year? Order by year.
gold_sql: SELECT year, sum(population) FROM country_stats GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;

question: Which Sub-Saharan African countries had a life expectancy above 70 years in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM country_stats s JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = s.iso3 WHERE c.region = 'Sub-Saharan Africa' AND s.year = 2023 AND s.life_expectancy_years > 70;

question: Show Germany's unemployment rate for each year from 2015 to 2023, ordered by year.
gold_sql: SELECT s.year, s.unemployment_pct FROM country_stats s JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = s.iso3 WHERE c.name = 'Germany' AND s.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2023 ORDER BY s.year;

question: What was the average fertility rate in each region in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT c.region, avg(s.fertility_rate) FROM country_stats s JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = s.iso3 WHERE s.year = 2023 GROUP BY c.region;

question: How many countries had a GDP above 1 trillion US dollars in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM country_stats WHERE year = 2023 AND gdp_usd > 1e12;

question: Which country in Europe & Central Asia had the lowest fertility rate in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM country_stats s JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = s.iso3 WHERE c.region = 'Europe & Central Asia' AND s.year = 2023 ORDER BY s.fertility_rate LIMIT 1;

question: What was the GDP of the United States in 2000 and in 2023? Show the year and GDP.
gold_sql: SELECT s.year, s.gdp_usd FROM country_stats s JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = s.iso3 WHERE c.name = 'United States' AND s.year IN (2000, 2023);

question: Which regions had an average internet usage above 70% in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT c.region FROM country_stats s JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = s.iso3 WHERE s.year = 2023 GROUP BY c.region HAVING avg(s.internet_users_pct) > 70;

question: By how many people did China's population grow between 2000 and 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT max(s.population) FILTER (WHERE s.year = 2023) - max(s.population) FILTER (WHERE s.year = 2000) FROM country_stats s JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = s.iso3 WHERE c.name = 'China';

question: Which 5 countries gained the most years of life expectancy between 2000 and 2023? Show the name and the gain, largest first.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, b.life_expectancy_years - a.life_expectancy_years AS gain FROM country_stats a JOIN country_stats b ON b.iso3 = a.iso3 AND b.year = 2023 JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = a.iso3 WHERE a.year = 2000 ORDER BY gain DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5;

question: What was the total GDP of each income group in 2023, from largest to smallest?
gold_sql: SELECT c.income_group, sum(s.gdp_usd) AS gdp FROM country_stats s JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = s.iso3 WHERE s.year = 2023 GROUP BY c.income_group ORDER BY gdp DESC;

question: Which countries had a GDP per capita above their region's average in 2023?
gold_sql: WITH x AS (SELECT c.name, c.region, s.gdp_per_capita_usd AS g FROM country_stats s JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = s.iso3 WHERE s.year = 2023) SELECT name FROM x WHERE g > (SELECT avg(g) FROM x AS y WHERE y.region = x.region);

question: What was the population-weighted average life expectancy of the world in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(life_expectancy_years * population) / sum(population) FROM country_stats WHERE year = 2023 AND life_expectancy_years IS NOT NULL AND population IS NOT NULL;

question: How many countries had a smaller population in 2023 than in 2010?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM country_stats a JOIN country_stats b ON b.iso3 = a.iso3 WHERE a.year = 2010 AND b.year = 2023 AND b.population < a.population;

question: Which countries had a life expectancy below 60 years in 2023? Show the name, region, and life expectancy.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, c.region, s.life_expectancy_years FROM country_stats s JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = s.iso3 WHERE s.year = 2023 AND s.life_expectancy_years < 60;

question: What share of the combined population lived in each region in 2023, as a percentage?
gold_sql: SELECT c.region, 100.0 * sum(s.population) / (SELECT sum(population) FROM country_stats WHERE year = 2023) FROM country_stats s JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = s.iso3 WHERE s.year = 2023 GROUP BY c.region;

question: Which countries have no GDP figure for 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM country_stats s JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = s.iso3 WHERE s.year = 2023 AND s.gdp_usd IS NULL;

question: Show France's GDP growth versus the previous year, as a percentage, for each year, ordered by year.
gold_sql: SELECT s.year, 100.0 * (s.gdp_usd - lag(s.gdp_usd) OVER (ORDER BY s.year)) / lag(s.gdp_usd) OVER (ORDER BY s.year) AS growth FROM country_stats s JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = s.iso3 WHERE c.name = 'France' ORDER BY s.year;

question: In each income group, which country had the highest GDP per capita in 2023? Show the income group, country name, and GDP per capita.
gold_sql: SELECT c.income_group, c.name, s.gdp_per_capita_usd FROM country_stats s JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = s.iso3 WHERE s.year = 2023 AND s.gdp_per_capita_usd IS NOT NULL QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.income_group ORDER BY s.gdp_per_capita_usd DESC) = 1;

question: What was the median urban population percentage in each region in 2023, from highest to lowest?
gold_sql: SELECT c.region, median(s.urban_population_pct) AS med FROM country_stats s JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = s.iso3 WHERE s.year = 2023 GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY med DESC;

question: Which countries had internet usage below 10% in 2010 but above 50% in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM country_stats a JOIN country_stats b ON b.iso3 = a.iso3 JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = a.iso3 WHERE a.year = 2010 AND b.year = 2023 AND a.internet_users_pct < 10 AND b.internet_users_pct > 50;

question: What is the correlation between GDP per capita and life expectancy across countries in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT corr(gdp_per_capita_usd, life_expectancy_years) FROM country_stats WHERE year = 2023;

question: List the 3 most populous countries in each region in 2023. Show the region, country name, and population.
gold_sql: SELECT c.region, c.name, s.population FROM country_stats s JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = s.iso3 WHERE s.year = 2023 QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.region ORDER BY s.population DESC) <= 3;

question: In 2020, which country had the highest unemployment rate in each region? Show the region, country name, and rate.
gold_sql: SELECT c.region, c.name, s.unemployment_pct FROM country_stats s JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = s.iso3 WHERE s.year = 2020 AND s.unemployment_pct IS NOT NULL QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.region ORDER BY s.unemployment_pct DESC) = 1;

question: For each region, in which year was the average life expectancy highest? Show the region, year, and average.
gold_sql: SELECT c.region, s.year, avg(s.life_expectancy_years) AS avg_le FROM country_stats s JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = s.iso3 GROUP BY c.region, s.year QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.region ORDER BY avg_le DESC) = 1;

question: How many penguins are in the dataset?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM penguins;

question: How many Gentoo penguins are there?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM penguins WHERE species = 'Gentoo';

question: Which islands were penguins recorded on?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT island FROM penguins;

question: What is the heaviest body mass recorded?
gold_sql: SELECT max(body_mass_g) FROM penguins;

question: How many penguins have an unknown sex?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM penguins WHERE sex IS NULL;

question: What is the average flipper length of all penguins?
gold_sql: SELECT avg(flipper_length_mm) FROM penguins;

question: How many penguins of each species are there?
gold_sql: SELECT species, count(*) FROM penguins GROUP BY species;

question: What is the average body mass of each species?
gold_sql: SELECT species, avg(body_mass_g) FROM penguins GROUP BY species;

question: How many penguins were recorded on each island in each year?
gold_sql: SELECT island, year, count(*) FROM penguins GROUP BY island, year;

question: What is the average bill length of male and of female penguins?
gold_sql: SELECT sex, avg(bill_length_mm) FROM penguins WHERE sex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sex;

question: Which species has the longest average flipper length?
gold_sql: SELECT species FROM penguins GROUP BY species ORDER BY avg(flipper_length_mm) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What are the minimum and maximum bill depths for each species?
gold_sql: SELECT species, min(bill_depth_mm), max(bill_depth_mm) FROM penguins GROUP BY species;

question: Which island has the most penguins?
gold_sql: SELECT island FROM penguins GROUP BY island ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the average body mass for each species and sex, leaving out penguins of unknown sex?
gold_sql: SELECT species, sex, avg(body_mass_g) FROM penguins WHERE sex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY species, sex;

question: Which species has the largest gap between the average body mass of males and females?
gold_sql: SELECT species FROM penguins GROUP BY species ORDER BY avg(body_mass_g) FILTER (WHERE sex = 'male') - avg(body_mass_g) FILTER (WHERE sex = 'female') DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many penguins are heavier than the average for their species?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM penguins p WHERE body_mass_g > (SELECT avg(body_mass_g) FROM penguins q WHERE q.species = p.species);

question: What percentage of the penguins on Biscoe island are Gentoo?
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE species = 'Gentoo') / count(*) FROM penguins WHERE island = 'Biscoe';

question: Show the number of penguins per species per year, ordered by species and then year.
gold_sql: SELECT species, year, count(*) FROM penguins GROUP BY species, year ORDER BY species, year;

question: Which islands are home to more than one species?
gold_sql: SELECT island FROM penguins GROUP BY island HAVING count(DISTINCT species) > 1;

question: What is the average ratio of bill length to bill depth for each species?
gold_sql: SELECT species, avg(bill_length_mm / bill_depth_mm) FROM penguins GROUP BY species;

question: What is the body mass of the heaviest penguin of each species? Show the species, island, and body mass.
gold_sql: SELECT species, island, body_mass_g FROM penguins WHERE body_mass_g IS NOT NULL QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY species ORDER BY body_mass_g DESC) = 1;

question: For each species, what was the average body mass in 2007 and in 2009? Show the species and both averages.
gold_sql: SELECT species, avg(body_mass_g) FILTER (WHERE year = 2007), avg(body_mass_g) FILTER (WHERE year = 2009) FROM penguins GROUP BY species;

question: Which species and island combinations have an average flipper length above the overall average? Show species and island.
gold_sql: SELECT species, island FROM penguins GROUP BY species, island HAVING avg(flipper_length_mm) > (SELECT avg(flipper_length_mm) FROM penguins);

question: Rank the species by average bill length, longest first. Show the rank, species, and average bill length.
gold_sql: SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY avg(bill_length_mm) DESC) AS rnk, species, avg(bill_length_mm) AS avg_bill FROM penguins GROUP BY species ORDER BY rnk;

question: What is the standard deviation of body mass for each species?
gold_sql: SELECT species, stddev_samp(body_mass_g) FROM penguins GROUP BY species;
